name: Pullquote on photo — depth stage
description: A pullquote on a moody photographic substrate, on the dimensional depth stage (ADR-0028, dex p20 image-substrate). The atmospheric photo (warm key + bokeh along the top, deep dark through the middle — composed FOR a centred quote) is the full-bleed backdrop plane, oversized to stay full-bleed across the camera move; the quote floats pin-sharp on the near plane in the dark zone (legibility 15:1, helped by a gentle contrast-darken pool). A slow camera push reprojects the planes at different rates for real parallax. The photographic softness/bokeh is BAKED into the substrate, and the runtime DOF aperture is 0 on purpose: the depth-stage gather makes the defocused background bleed into (bloom around) the bright crisp text, so the look comes from the image, the depth stage from the parallax. The substrate is a bundled, deterministic in-repo image (atmosphere-warm) on the backdrop plane's textured branch; backgroundFill is the opaque-lane backstop.

content.title: Build on bedrock. The tide goes out; bedrock stays.
content.author: Scott Tolinski
